card.title: 5th BERSAGLIERI
card.text: Destruction: Shuffle 18th BERSAGLIERI into your deck.
card.flavorText: The 5th Bersaglieri Regiment was part of Italy’s elite light infantry, known for its mobility and marksmanship. During WWII, it was assigned to the 131st Armored Division "Centauro", first seeing action in the Greco-Italian War. Operating in the rugged terrain of Epirus and Albania, the regiment engaged in tough mountain warfare where its agility proved valuable. In late 1942, the division was transferred to North Africa as part of the Axis response to British advances. Arriving in Libya, the 5th Bersaglieri fought in the Tunisian campaign, the final phase of the North African conflict. It took part in delaying actions and defensive battles under increasingly difficult conditions, facing Allied superiority in air power and armor. In May 1943, the regiment, along with the rest of the Centauro Division, was destroyed during the collapse of Axis forces in Tunisia. The 5th Bersaglieri had a long lineage dating back to the 19th century and earned several decorations, including the Military Order of Italy and medals for valor. It was one of the last Bersaglieri regiments to fight in North Africa before the Italian surrender in that theater.
